messages:
kai: deploy-bot rolled canary to eu-west at 10% for v2026.03.22. noticed p99 tail rising. anyone watching?

deploy-bot: deploy started: v2026.03.22-canary -> service/inference-eu (traffic=10%) by kai. run: https://deploys.redwood/1754309999

sre_oncall: looking. p99 on /v1/generate spiked ~600ms around 1754309940. traces show contention in scheduler. new runtime flag in release: dynamic_batch_window=true

ops_lead: recommendation: STOP ramp, set traffic to 0% and retain canary nodes for debugging. avoid full rollback until we confirm cause.

miriam: +1 stop and pin. can stage a flag revert on canary infra group if SRE confirms.

kai: stop agreed. deploy-bot, set traffic to 0% for canary in eu-west.

deploy-bot: action: traffic update requested by kai. setting v2026.03.22-canary traffic to 0% in eu-west. (id=rb-1754309999-01)

sre_oncall: confirming traces align with batch-window aggregation causing scheduling stalls. recommend revert flag on canary only.

ops_lead: roll decision: revert infra flag on canary, do not change model. miriam, can you apply patch?

miriam: ready. patch: ```kubectl patch configmap infra-flags -n inference --type=merge -p '{"data":{"dynamic_batch_window":"false"}}'``` applying to canary infra now.

deploy-bot: config patch applied to canary infra group. monitoring window 5m.

sre_oncall: p99 trending back to baseline within 90s of patch. leave traffic at 0% for 10m then consider 5% retest.

kai: noted. I'll add an incident blurb to release notes: "Paused EU canary; disabled dynamic_batch_window on canary infra after latency spike. Investigating."

ops_lead: decision log: STOP -> pin -> infra-flag revert on canary -> 10m observation -> possible 5% relaunch.

miriam: will capture perf dumps for 15m and tag traces with rollout=1754309999.

kai: thanks everyone. stay tuned if we see regression.
